title: Relative Serre vanishing for a proper morphism
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $f:X\to S$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] such that, for every affine open $V\subseteq S$, the restriction $\mathcal L|_{f^{-1}(V)}$ is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then there is an integer $n_0$ such that $R^p f_*(\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})=0$ for every $n\ge n_0$ and every $p>0.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.17.1 (Tag 02O1), label lemma-kill-by-twisting

proof.text: For each t in S choose an affine open neighbourhood V. Its ring A = Gamma(S,V) is Noetherian. Set g = (f restricted to V) followed by the canonical affine isomorphism V -> Spec A. Properness is stable under this base change and composition with an isomorphism. Restrict F to f^{-1}V; it remains coherent by the restriction clause of coherent_module_local_on_open_cover. The supplied hL gives an invertible ample restriction of L. Apply exists_isZero_moduleCohomology_tensorPow_of_ample to g and these restrictions, obtaining a natural-number bound n_V uniform in all positive degrees.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.17.1 (Tag 02O1), label lemma-kill-by-twisting

proof.text: Use openRestrictionNumeratorIso to identify the restriction of F tensor L^n with F restricted tensor the nth power of L restricted, including n=0. Transport the module cohomology vanishing through this isomorphism. The additive source comparison exists_moduleCohomology_source_comparison turns it into Subsingleton of the source-library H. Apply isZero_higherDirectImage_of_subsingleton_H to g. This existing lemma combines the affine-base sections comparison, quasi-coherence of the higher direct image, and the tilde-global-sections counit to detect the zero sheaf.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.17.1 (Tag 02O1), label lemma-kill-by-twisting

proof.text: Transport the open-base-change pullback square along V -> Spec A. Apply nonempty_higherDirectImage_iso_restrict, identifying pullback of the coefficient along the source open immersion with restriction via restrictFunctorIsoPullback. This makes the restriction of R^p f_*(F tensor L^n) along fromSpec zero. Vanishing along an open immersion implies vanishing on its open range; this range is exactly V. The whole local argument is the Lean local assertion key, with no new public theorem or sorry.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.17.1 (Tag 02O1), label lemma-kill-by-twisting

proof.text: Choose these neighbourhoods and bounds for every point, extract a finite subcover of the compact Noetherian base, and take the Finset.sup of its natural-number bounds. For n above that supremum and p>0, each point lies in a selected V whose bound is <= n, so the sheaf restricts to zero near every point. Apply isZero_of_forall_exists_isZero_restrict. Finset.sup is zero on the empty cover, so the empty base is included.
